name: order-confirmation-card
description: Post-checkout receipt card with success status, order ID, product line items, ship-to, paid total, and dual actions.
purpose: Gives an ecommerce landing a trusted order-complete moment shoppers can read, save, and act on without opening a dashboard.
bestFor: campaign landings that preview a packed order
avoidFor: live checkout that still needs a payment form
account order history with many past carts
event tickets that need a scan barcode

files.content:
